text:
Predicates:
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x was translated from y.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x was published by y.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
House(x) ::: x is a house.
Literature(x) ::: x is literature.
Foreign(x) ::: x is foreign.
English(x) ::: x is in English.
Italian(x) ::: x is Italian.
Premises:
∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress) → InLanguage(x, english)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
NeapolitanChronicles is published by New Vessel Press.
NeapolitanChronicles was translated from Italian.
PalaceOfFlies is published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
TranslatedFrom(palaceOfFlies, italian) ::: Palace of Flies was translated from Italian.
